claims.text: The IPA system interacts with users to gather information and accumulates structured and labeled training data in the background.
By interacting with users, the IPA system augments resources with structured and labeled training data for further implementation of learnable dialogue components.
The system reduces repetitive tasks and allows workers to focus on complex questions while collecting structured dialogues for retraining.
